lines.zh: 女皇挪动身躯，整条隧道都在颤
lines.en: The queen shifts her bulk, and the whole tunnel trembles.

lines.zh: 腹囊拖在身后，留下一道湿痕
lines.en: Her brood sac drags behind, leaving a wet trail.

lines.zh: 六足踏过菌毯，声音沉闷如鼓
lines.en: Six legs drum over the fungus carpet, low as a drum.

lines.zh: 她不急，整座巢等她走到尽头
lines.en: She is in no hurry; the nest waits for her.

lines.zh: 巨腹擦过石壁，刮下一层苔
lines.en: Her vast abdomen scrapes the stone, shaving off moss.

lines.zh: 工蚁纷纷让道，不敢贴近她的足
lines.en: Workers scatter from her feet, keeping their distance.

lines.zh: 她沿着主廊巡视自己的产房
lines.en: She patrols the main gallery toward her brood chamber.

lines.zh: 螫针收在腹下，随步伐轻晃
lines.en: Her sting rests beneath her abdomen, swaying as she walks.

lines.zh: 通道为她拓宽过，仍嫌狭窄
lines.en: The tunnel was widened for her, and still feels narrow.

lines.zh: 触角先探三步，身体才跟上
lines.en: Her antennae probe three steps ahead before she follows.

lines.zh: 她伏在卵堆上，缓缓收拢节肢
lines.en: She settles over the egg pile, folding her limbs slowly.

lines.zh: 腹囊一鼓一缩，里面在动
lines.en: Her brood sac swells and slackens; something moves inside.

lines.zh: 低鸣从颚间漏出，像地底闷雷
lines.en: A low hum escapes her mandibles, like thunder underground.

lines.zh: 她用前足拂去卵壳上的尘土
lines.en: She brushes dust from the eggshells with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 整座蚁穴的气味都由她定下
lines.en: The scent of the entire colony is set by her alone.

lines.zh: 她数着新孵的幼虫，一只不落
lines.en: She counts the new larvae, missing none.

lines.zh: 工蚁送来嚼碎的食物，她张口接住
lines.en: A worker brings pre-chewed food; she opens her jaws to take it.

lines.zh: 她不动时，石壁上的苔也安静
lines.en: When she is still, even the moss on the walls goes quiet.

lines.zh: 双角抵着洞顶，磨出浅浅凹槽
lines.en: Her twin horns press the ceiling, wearing shallow grooves.

lines.zh: 她把螫针在石上磨了两下
lines.en: She hones her sting twice against the stone.

lines.zh: 她听着巢里每一只蚂蚁的脚步
lines.en: She listens to the footsteps of every ant in the nest.

lines.zh: 翅芽早已退化，她本就不需要飞
lines.en: Her wing buds long since withered; she never needed flight.

lines.zh: 她舔净巨颚上的碎屑，动作很慢
lines.en: She licks her great mandibles clean, slowly.

lines.zh: 洞顶渗水，她挪了半尺避开
lines.en: Seepage drips from the ceiling; she shifts half a pace aside.

lines.zh: 她把触角搭在卵上，像在数数
lines.en: She rests her antennae on the eggs, as if counting

lines.zh: 洞顶的水滴在她背上，她不理会
lines.en: A drop falls from the ceiling onto her back. She ignores it

lines.zh: 她抬起角，正对着你的眼睛
lines.en: She lifts her horns level with your eyes.

lines.zh: 女皇打量你，像在称一块肉
lines.en: The queen weighs you the way one weighs meat.

lines.zh: 她认得你的气味，不属于这巢
lines.en: She knows your scent; it does not belong to this nest.

lines.zh: 六只眼同时转向，没有一只眨
lines.en: Six eyes turn at once, and none of them blink.

lines.zh: 她盯着你的脚，估算还能退几步
lines.en: She stares at your feet, measuring how far you can retreat.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，原本是她产卵的侧室
lines.en: You are standing in what was her egg chamber.

lines.zh: 她低头的角度，恰好够着你的咽喉
lines.en: She lowers her head just enough to reach your throat.

lines.zh: 她把你看作闯进育婴室的虫
lines.en: She takes you for an insect that wandered into the nursery.

lines.zh: 触角在空中停住，指向你的方向
lines.en: Her antennae freeze in the air, pointed at you.

lines.zh: 她没有吼，沉默比吼更重
lines.en: She does not roar; her silence carries more weight.

lines.zh: 女皇记住了你站的位置
lines.en: The queen has memorized where you stand.

lines.zh: 她眼皮下的巨颚动了一下
lines.en: Her mandibles twitch beneath half-lidded eyes.

lines.zh: 她发出极低的轰鸣，洞顶落土
lines.en: She gives a deep rumble, and soil falls from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出淡黄的体液
lines.en: Pale hemolymph seeps from the wound.

lines.zh: 她缩了一下，甲壳上有白痕
lines.en: She flinches; a white scar shows on her chitin.

lines.zh: 这一下只让她更慢、更沉
lines.en: The blow only makes her slower and heavier.

lines.zh: 她转身，把受伤的一侧藏到后面
lines.en: She turns, tucking her injured side behind her.

lines.zh: 剧痛让她把颚张到最大
lines.en: The pain makes her open her jaws to their widest.

lines.zh: 她脚下的工蚁被震得四散
lines.en: The workers at her feet scatter from the shock.

lines.zh: 她嘶了一声，像漏气的风箱
lines.en: She hisses like a leaking bellows.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了一道，她仍旧站着
lines.en: Her shell cracks, and she is still standing.

lines.zh: 她把痛咽下去，继续向前
lines.en: She swallows the pain and keeps moving forward.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，她连头都没偏
lines.en: You hold out food; she does not tilt her head.

lines.zh: 女皇不吃递到嘴边的碎食
lines.en: The queen does not eat scraps offered to her mouth.

lines.zh: 巢里食物由工蚁先尝，她才动口
lines.en: Workers taste the food first; only then does she eat.

lines.zh: 她把你的诱饵当成巢里的垃圾
lines.en: She takes your lure for refuse in her nest.

lines.zh: 甜味飘过来，她只是嗅了嗅
lines.en: The sweetness drifts over; she merely sniffs.

lines.zh: 她饿的时候，自会叫工蚁来喂
lines.en: When hungry, she simply calls a worker to feed her.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，喂不饱一座蚁穴
lines.en: What you hold cannot feed a whole colony.

lines.zh: 她绕过食物，去看墙里的卵
lines.en: She walks past the food to check the eggs in the wall.

lines.zh: 女皇只认巢的气味，不认你的好意
lines.en: She trusts the nest's scent, not your kindness.

lines.zh: 你把果子放下，她让工蚁搬走
lines.en: You set the fruit down; she has workers carry it off.

lines.zh: 她撞过来，像一面会走动的墙
lines.en: She bumps into you like a walking wall.

lines.zh: 一次碰撞，你被顶退了两步
lines.en: One collision and you are shoved back two steps.

lines.zh: 甲壳相碰，你的骨头先响
lines.en: Chitin meets bone, and your bones creak first.

lines.zh: 她不需要加速，重量就够了
lines.en: She needs no speed; her weight is enough.

lines.zh: 你撞了她一下，只晃了晃触角
lines.en: You bump her; only her antennae sway.

lines.zh: 巨腹一摆，把你挤向石壁
lines.en: Her huge abdomen swings and presses you to the wall.

lines.zh: 她低头看你，像在看一粒砂
lines.en: She looks down at you as at a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 女皇的肩甲撞得你后退
lines.en: The queen's shoulder plate knocks you backward.

lines.zh: 你撞上她的前足，像撞上树桩
lines.en: You hit her foreleg as if hitting a tree stump.

lines.zh: 她懒得让路，只把身体侧了侧
lines.en: She cannot be bothered to yield, only shifts slightly.

lines.zh: 她不需要伴侣，一巢只容一只女皇
lines.en: She needs no partner; one queen to a nest.

lines.zh: 生育是她的特权，也是她的锁链
lines.en: Bearing young is her privilege and her chain.

lines.zh: 所有雄蚁的下场，她都记得清楚
lines.en: She remembers exactly how every male before her ended.

lines.zh: 她把新产的卵一粒粒码好
lines.en: She stacks the newly laid eggs one by one.

lines.zh: 她的腹部鼓胀，装着整座巢的未来
lines.en: Her abdomen is swollen with the nest's whole future.

lines.zh: 求婚的雄蚁在洞口就被工蚁拦下
lines.en: Suitors are stopped by workers at the tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 她只挑气味最像自己的那一只
lines.en: She chooses only the male whose scent is most like hers.

lines.zh: 产卵之后，她连水都不肯多喝
lines.en: After laying, she will not even drink extra water.

lines.zh: 女皇的血脉只有一条，绝不分岔
lines.en: The queen's bloodline runs in one line, never forking.

lines.zh: 巢里每只蚂蚁都喊她母亲
lines.en: Every ant in the nest calls her mother.

lines.zh: 东西落在脚边，她没有弯腰
lines.en: Something falls by her feet; she does not stoop.

lines.zh: 女皇不搬东西，那是工蚁的活
lines.en: The queen carries nothing; that is workers' work.

lines.zh: 她用颚拨了拨，把它推给跟班
lines.en: She nudges it with her mandibles, toward an attendant.

lines.zh: 一块树脂，她闻了闻就丢下
lines.en: A lump of resin; she sniffs and drops it.

lines.zh: 她叼起卵，挪到更暖的角落
lines.en: She picks up an egg and moves it to a warmer corner.

lines.zh: 你扔的矿石，她踩着走了过去
lines.en: You toss ore; she walks right over it.

lines.zh: 她只搬自己的幼虫，其余不管
lines.en: She carries only her larvae, nothing else.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，由她决定谁去捡
lines.en: What lies on the floor, she decides who collects.

lines.zh: 她把碎壳推到墙角堆着
lines.en: She sweeps the broken shells into a corner pile.

lines.zh: 女皇的颚只用来夹骨，不夹杂物
lines.en: Her jaws are for bone, not for oddments.

lines.zh: 她把头转向你，卵也不看了
lines.en: She turns her head from the eggs toward you.

lines.zh: 你踩碎一只工蚁，她立刻抬头
lines.en: You crush a worker, and her head snaps up.

lines.zh: 巢里的气味乱了，她找到了源头
lines.en: The nest's scent sours; she finds the source.

lines.zh: 她判定你是入侵者，不是客人
lines.en: She decides you are an intruder, not a guest.

lines.zh: 女皇起身，卵堆在她身后晃
lines.en: The queen rises, the egg pile swaying behind her.

lines.zh: 她没叫，整座蚁穴却都动了
lines.en: She makes no sound, yet the whole nest stirs.

lines.zh: 她的螫针从腹下抬了起来
lines.en: Her sting rises from beneath her abdomen.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，她已经记住了这一步
lines.en: You step back once; she has marked that step.

lines.zh: 她把巨颚开合了一次，像在试刀
lines.en: She opens and closes her jaws once, testing them.

lines.zh: 工蚁让开，给她腾出一条直路
lines.en: Workers part, clearing a straight path for her.

lines.zh: 她盯上你了，产房的门就此关上
lines.en: She has chosen you; the nursery door closes.

lines.zh: 她的怒火很慢，但不会消退
lines.en: Her anger comes slowly, but it does not fade.

lines.zh: 你成了这个巢第一件要清掉的东西
lines.en: You are the first thing this nest means to clear out.

lines.zh: 她朝你爬来，地面开始震
lines.en: She crawls toward you, and the ground begins to shake.

lines.zh: 她把整座巢的注意力挪到你身上
lines.en: She shifts the whole nest's attention onto you

lines.zh: 你踩响的那块碎石，她听见了
lines.en: She heard the gravel you snapped

lines.zh: 她慢慢撑起身体，甲壳咔咔响
lines.en: She slowly rises, her shell clicking

lines.zh: 她把你从巢里的住客中划掉了
lines.en: She has struck you from the nest's list of residents

lines.zh: 她不追，只一步步封住退路
lines.en: She does not chase; she closes your retreat step by step.

lines.zh: 螫针尖端对着你，微微发亮
lines.en: The tip of her sting aims at you, faintly gleaming.

lines.zh: 她低鸣，洞壁上的土簌簌落
lines.en: She hums low, and soil sifts from the walls.

lines.zh: 她绕到你和出口之间
lines.en: She moves between you and the exit.

lines.zh: 八步之内，她随时能扑上来
lines.en: Within eight paces she could lunge at any moment.

lines.zh: 她抬起前足，露出腹下的节
lines.en: She lifts her forelegs, baring the segments beneath.

lines.zh: 她的影子把你整个罩住
lines.en: Her shadow covers you entirely.

lines.zh: 她不喊，只用颚敲了两下石壁
lines.en: She makes no cry, only raps the wall twice with her jaws.

lines.zh: 她已经把你归进要清走的那一类
lines.en: She has filed you under things to be removed.

lines.zh: 她计算着你与洞口的距离
lines.en: She is calculating your distance from the tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 每靠近一步，她的螫针就抬高一分
lines.en: Each step closer, her sting lifts a little higher.

lines.zh: 她不给你绕到背后的机会
lines.en: She gives you no chance to get behind her.

lines.zh: 整座蚁穴都在为她让路
lines.en: The whole nest clears a road for her.

lines.zh: 她的耐心比你想象的更短
lines.en: Her patience is shorter than you imagined.

lines.zh: 她用前足探你退走的那条道
lines.en: She probes with a foreleg the path you retreated along

lines.zh: 她的低鸣在隧道里连成一片
lines.en: Her low drone joins into one long note through the tunnels

lines.zh: 她不急，出口已经被封住
lines.en: She is in no hurry. The exit is already sealed

lines.zh: 她算准了你只能往低处走
lines.en: She has worked out that you can only go lower

lines.zh: 巨颚轻轻开合，像在数拍子
lines.en: Her mandibles open and close lightly, like counting a beat

lines.zh: 她不看你的脸，只盯着你的脚
lines.en: She ignores your face and watches only your feet

lines.zh: 螫针扎下，你被抛出去十米
lines.en: The sting strikes, and you are flung ten meters.

lines.zh: 巨颚合拢，骨头发出脆响
lines.en: Her great mandibles close with a crisp crack.

lines.zh: 她一头撞来，把你顶翻在地
lines.en: She slams her head in, knocking you flat.

lines.zh: 螫针只中了一次，你就飞了出去
lines.en: One touch of her sting sends you flying.

lines.zh: 她咬住护甲，像咬一片干叶
lines.en: She bites your armor as if it were a dry leaf.

lines.zh: 巨颚一夹，盾牌凹了下去
lines.en: Her jaws clamp; the shield dents inward.

lines.zh: 她的前足压住你，另一只抬了起来
lines.en: One foreleg pins you; the other rises.

lines.zh: 那一击把你送进对面的石壁
lines.en: That blow sends you into the far wall.

lines.zh: 她甩头，你跟着被甩了出去
lines.en: She whips her head, and you are thrown with it.

lines.zh: 螫针带着毒，伤口先麻后痛
lines.en: Her sting carries venom; the wound numbs, then burns.

lines.zh: 她压上全身重量，甲壳咯咯响
lines.en: She leans her full weight down; chitin creaks.

lines.zh: 巨颚擦过你的肩膀，衣衫裂开
lines.en: Her mandibles graze your shoulder, splitting cloth.

lines.zh: 她一击之后不停，第二击已到
lines.en: She does not pause after one blow; the second lands.

lines.zh: 你被顶飞，落地时已在走廊尽头
lines.en: You are batted away, landing at the gallery's end.

lines.zh: 深处的卵壳裂开，她撑起身体
lines.en: Deep below, the shell splits and she lifts herself.

lines.zh: 新女皇睁眼，六只眼同时亮起
lines.en: The new queen opens six eyes at once.

lines.zh: 她第一次抖动腹囊，巢有了心跳
lines.en: She shakes her brood sac for the first time; the nest has a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 工蚁围上来，用触角碰她的颚
lines.en: Workers crowd close, touching her jaws with their antennae.

lines.zh: 她从卵室爬出，第一次踩上主廊
lines.en: She climbs from the egg chamber onto the main gallery.

lines.zh: 石壁为她让开，通道正被挖宽
lines.en: The stone yields; the passage is being widened for her.

lines.zh: 她的低鸣传遍每一间侧室
lines.en: Her low hum reaches every side chamber.

lines.zh: 蚁穴有了主人，气味从此固定
lines.en: The nest has a mistress; its scent is fixed from now on.

lines.zh: 她先尝了一口巢里的存粮
lines.en: She tastes the nest's stored food first.

lines.zh: 双角顶破最后一层土，她出来了
lines.en: Her horns break the last layer of soil; she emerges.

lines.zh: 她身后，第一批工蚁正在破茧
lines.en: Behind her, the first workers are breaking their cocoons.

lines.zh: 她抬头，第一次看见洞顶的根须
lines.en: She looks up and sees roots through the ceiling for the first time.

lines.zh: 这片地底，从今天起归她
lines.en: This patch of underworld belongs to her from today.

lines.zh: 她产下第一窝卵，巢开始运转
lines.en: She lays her first clutch, and the nest begins to run.

lines.zh: 旧的卵壳空了，她被推了出来
lines.en: The old egg case is empty. She was pushed out of it

lines.zh: 她第一次试着发声，声音很低
lines.en: She tries her voice for the first time. It is low

lines.zh: 主廊的土还是新的，她走了一遍
lines.en: The soil of the main corridor is still fresh. She walks it once

lines.zh: 工蚁围着她，把气味记了下来
lines.en: Workers surround her, learning her scent

lines.zh: 她抬头，洞顶比卵室高太多
lines.en: She looks up. The ceiling is far higher than the egg chamber

lines.zh: 从这窝卵起，这巢姓她的名
lines.en: From this clutch on, the nest bears her name

lines.zh: 火燎过甲壳，她退进湿土里
lines.en: Fire washes her shell; she backs into wet soil.

lines.zh: 她砸在地上，腹囊重重一颤
lines.en: She hits the ground, her brood sac jolting hard.

lines.zh: 水灌进气门，她的动作乱了
lines.en: Water floods her spiracles, and her movements break rhythm.

lines.zh: 爆风掀翻了她，六足朝天
lines.en: The blast flips her, six legs to the sky.

lines.zh: 箭钉在甲壳上，没能进去
lines.en: The arrow sticks in her shell but does not pierce it.

lines.zh: 符文烧灼她的节间，她扭身避开
lines.en: Runes sear between her segments; she twists away.

lines.zh: 巢里断粮，她的腹囊瘪了
lines.en: The nest runs out of food; her brood sac shrinks.

lines.zh: 雷击落在背上，她浑身一僵
lines.en: Lightning strikes her back, and she goes rigid.

lines.zh: 虚空扯住她，甲壳在剥落
lines.en: The void pulls at her, peeling her shell away.
